text.en:
The paragraph headed "Bureau of Constabulary" in section one of Act Numbered Twenty-two
hundred and eight, as amended by section one (ft) of Act Numbered Twenty-two hundred and sixty-eight, is
hereby amended to read as follows:
"BUREAU OF CONSTABULARY.
"For salaries and wages and duly authorized contingent expenses of the Bureau of Constabulary, including
maintenance and repair of Insular buildings, for use in the Moro Province, the Mountain Province, and the
Provinces of Agusan and Nueva Vizcaya, nine hundred and eighty thousand pesos.
Additional officers. "The appointment in the manner and at the salaries provided by law of one additional
lieutenant-colonel and assistant director, one additional major, three additional captains, one additional captain
and surgeon, five additional first lieutenants, one additional first lieutenant and medical inspector, and five
additional second lieutenants is hereby authorized."

This Act shall take effect as of January first, nineteen hundred and thirteen.
Enacted, April 18, 1913.
